summary: controller profile with jog, motor, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): Serato DJ Pro.
identityNotes: Research seed; DDJ-REV7 manufacturer documentation establishes PC/Mac USB audio routing with 10 inputs and 10 outputs per host connection, 48 kHz/24-bit audio format and USB MIDI. Hardware revision, firmware, current OS support, USB IDs, class compliance, exact MIDI control maps and measured tolerances remain unqualified.

documents.title: MIDI implementation chart (not verified)
documents.notes: Use MIDI Learn or the published mapping; HID events may not appear as MIDI.

documents.title: DDJ-REV7 Instruction Manual DRI1713-D
documents.notes: Exact DDJ-REV7; DRI1713-D, copyright 2021, checked 2026-11-18. Printed pp. 21-24 and 30 document PC/Mac driver/utility routing: five USB pairs in each direction per host connection, including FX sends/returns. P. 106 specifies 48 kHz and 24-bit conversion; p. 105 documents USB MIDI. Document revision is not qualified firmware.

documents.title: Manufacturer controller comparison: DDJ-REV7 audio interface
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18; no document revision date identified. Audio Spec / Audio IF - Sampling Rate: DDJ-REV7 column states 48k/24bit. Numeric USB channel counts instead use the manual's numbered routing screenshots.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-REV7; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-REV7 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Motorized deck and MAGVEL scratch control
steps: Run supported Serato DJ Pro or rekordbox mode and rotate motorized platters.
Verify both jog displays, start/stop and touch sensitivity.
Sweep the MAGVEL crossfader and record audio cut/bleed.
